name: AHE Audio Design Tokens
principles: Crisp native/vector graphics and studio-readability first
Purple for selection/main creative action; green for actual enabled processing state
Never use color alone to communicate state
No fake audio meters, fake FX modules, or fictional preset behavior
Retain compact plugin usability at 520x360; larger layouts only when practical and tested
Separate host chrome from plugin interface
Use clean readable UI text; brand display lettering only for logo/product names
